ImageDescription.value: PEARL HARBOR, Hawaii (May 4, 2007) - Quartermaster 2nd Class Lisa Kaeser, assigned to guided missile destroyer USS Hopper (DDG 70), stands by to release a mooring line as Sailors aboard the Pearl Harbor-based guided missile cruiser USS Lake Erie (CG 70) prepare to depart for a deployment to the western Pacific.
